title: Life and Death Pact
next_chapter_hook: The moment Ye Qing's voice fell, a cold transmission talisman silently pierced through the void. The aura contained within the talisman caused Chen Ji's gaze to freeze—the emergency recall order came from within the Holy Sect.

text.content: Night wind like silk, carrying the pine song from the deep mountains, made the star river even clearer. Silver-white radiance poured down, weaving a thin cold mist around the two of them. Chen Ji stood on the blue stone at the cliff's edge, his robes lifted and dropped by the wind. On that usually calm face, a trace of inexplicable complex expression appeared. 'After breaking the Heavenly Dao, will you take me away?'—Ye Qing's just spoken words were still like a stone thrown into a lake of the heart, rippling in the depths of his chest. He didn't answer immediately, because the answer itself was far heavier than this question.

Ye Qing stood three steps away, the Demonic Path's unique ghostly purple spiritual light flickering around her, making that cold and beautiful face appear even deeper and unfathomable. Her gaze always fell on Chen Ji, unflinching, as if waiting for a verdict that could change her fate. Three years—since that prophecy from the Tianji Record shattered her last trace of loyalty to the Holy Sect, she had bet everything on this seemingly useless youth. Now, all her sacrifices and endurance condensed into this silent question before her eyes. Her fingertips tightened slightly, her palms damp with thin sweat. The star river was silent, yet she seemed to hear the echo of her own heartbeat. The shackles of the Holy Sect, the prison of the Heavenly Dao, the shore of freedom—these words interweaved and surged in her mind, weaving into a net called anticipation and fear.

dialogue.content: 'You know, I cannot promise the outcome.' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice low and steady, like stream water flowing over pebbles, 'But I can promise one thing—if one day the Heavenly Dao crumbles, the last place Chen Ji walks will surely be by your side, Ye Qing.' He slowly turned to face her, their eyes meeting. Those eyes that had always remained unruffled now ignited with a faint yet firm flame.

text.content: These words fell into Ye Qing's ears, shaking her spirit more than any earth-shaking oath. She knew this man too well—calculating, cold as iron, never doing anything without certainty, never making promises lightly. Yet now, he answered with 'the last place.' What did this mean? It meant that even if the path ahead was a thousand-foot abyss, a death sentence, he would still lead her out of the mire. Even if the Heavenly Dao remained unbroken, even through endless calamity, he would never abandon her. Her nose suddenly stung, and in those usually cold and fierce eyes, a faint layer of moisture appeared. Three years of endurance and pretense nearly collapsed in this moment.

Above the cliff, two figures stood facing each other. As the star river flowed, the entire world seemed to quiet, save for the night wind's whimper through the pines and the distant cry of some nameless night bird. Chen Ji's long hair was blown up by the wind, a few ink-black strands crossing his brow, hiding the fleeting softness in his eyes. He looked at this woman known for her cold severity, at her forcibly calm yet slightly trembling eyelashes, and felt an ache in the softest corner of his heart. She should not have to bear all this—being used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect, as a bargaining chip by fate, forced to place her hopes on a residual soul within atrash body. In this moment, the chess game he had been playing for countless years stirred with an impulse to overturn the board for her sake.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's eye sockets had turned slightly red, and she waited for a more concrete response—one that would make her completely entrust her trust. Chen Ji, how will you deepen this pact?

choices.description: Using essence blood as the guide and souls as the contract, form a life-and-death oath with Ye Qing, completely binding both fates together.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's 100% trust, unlock 'Shared Fate' prerequisite
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value drops to a dangerous line; if encountering a powerful enemy, the Foresight Ability will be lost

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, using his finger as a blade, cutting a wound deep enough to see bone in his palm. The moment blood gushed forth, a scorching aura rose from the wound, faintly glowing with golden light—that was essence blood fused with the Tianji Record's aura, each drop precious beyond measure.

dialogue.content: 'You're mad!' Ye Qing cried out, instinctively reaching to stop him, yet Chen Ji had already extended his bloodied palm before her. 'Blood as covenant, soul as oath.' His voice was calm to the point of coldness, 'From this day forward, your life is my life. Your enemy is my enemy. If I betray this oath—heaven abandons me, earth destroys me, never to be reborn through the cycle of transmigration.'

choices.description: Using a key secret about Ye Qing's origin from among the Tianji Record Fragments as leverage, proving absolute control over her fate.
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing will reveal the Holy Sect's highest secrets in return
choices.risk_hint: Once secrets are spoken, they cannot be taken back, potentially affecting subsequent arrangements

text.content: Chen Ji drew a yellowed fragment from his bosom—this was the supplementary part of the Tianji Record's second volume, its characters barely visible under the starlight. 'Do you know why you are called the 'Demonic Path Sacred Maiden'?' He handed the fragment to Ye Qing, 'The Holy Sect chose you, not because of your talent, but because of the blood flowing within you—the direct lineage of the ancient Demon Sovereign.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's complexion instantly turned deathly pale, her delicate frame trembling violently. She had never imagined her origins concealed such astonishing truth. Those questions about her lineage, those silences from Holy Sect elders that spoke volumes—all now had answers. She raised her head, gazing at Chen Ji with an almost fearful expression, her voice shaking: 'You... knew from the very beginning?'

choices.description: Make no verbal promise, only gently take Ye Qing's hand under the starry sky, letting actions speak louder than oaths.
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's affection has increased significantly, but trust is improving more slowly.
choices.risk_hint: Lacking substantial constraints, future variables may emerge.

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely raising his hand slowly and extending it toward Ye Qing. Starlight cast a faint silver glow onto his palm, illuminating the calluses born from years of cultivation. Ye Qing stared blankly at that hand, her pupils slightly contracting. She had witnessed his coldness in placing chess pieces, his composure in scheming for world domination, yet never seen him make such... such a tender gesture.

After a moment of hesitation, she finally extended her hand, covering his palm. Their fingers intertwined—Ye Qing's fingertips ice-cold, while Chen Ji's palm carried a faint warmth. Night wind passed between them, lifting the stray hair by her temples, yet failing to dispel the tranquility and warmth pervading the air. No words were necessary—some promises, once spoken, become desecration.

The night wind grew chill, yet the starry river shone even more brilliantly. After an unknown duration, Chen Ji was the first to break the silence. His voice returned to its usual calm, as if that momentary tenderness had merely been an illusion. 'A blood oath carries a steep price.' He lowered his gaze to the wound on his palm, where pale golden blood continued seeping slowly. 'But there are things worth more than the Heavenly Fate.' His tone was light, as if stating an unrelated fact, yet within those deep eyes lurked a softness he himself might not even be aware of. Three years of scheming had made him accustomed to treating all as chess pieces. Yet this woman before him stirred within him the unprecedented urge to leap out of the chessboard and grasp the pieces himself.

Upon hearing his words, Ye Qing's heart trembled once more. Gazing at his still-bleeding palm, she suddenly reached into her sleeve and retrieved a jet-black jade token. Intricate, obscure symbols densely covered its surface, emitting a ghostly purple glow in the night. 'This is the Holy Sect Saintess Token.' Her voice was somewhat hoarse. 'Gather seven of these, and you can mobilize three-tenths of the Holy Sect's reserves.' She solemnly placed the token into Chen Ji's palm. 'This is my oath of allegiance. From this day forward, my life, my resources, everything I have—may serve your purposes.' Her gaze burned as she stared at Chen Ji. 'In exchange, I demand you remember today's promise. When you break the Heavenly Dao, bring me out of the Demonic Path. If you break your word—' She paused, a fierce gleam flickering in her eyes. 'Even if I become a vengeful ghost, I will come to collect your life.'

Chen Ji accepted the token, his fingertips brushing across those cold symbols. His lips curved slightly upward. That smile was faint, yet carried genuine delight. 'Vengeful ghost collecting life?' He tucked the token into his chest. 'That sounds like quite a fitting ending.' His tone was nonchalant, as if discussing tonight's moonlight. 'But rest assured, I, Chen Ji, never break my word. Especially—' He tilted his head slightly, his gaze falling upon Ye Qing's coldly beautiful face. 'For someone important.' These four words were spoken softly, yet weighed like a thousand pounds. Ye Qing's form stiffened almost imperceptibly, and a faint blushquietly appeared at her ears, rendering her breathtakingly radiant beneath the starlight.

dialogue.content: 'Smooth talker.' Ye Qing turned away, masking her momentary loss of composure. 'If you truly have the ability, first complete the Tianji Record before spouting grand promises.' Her voice recovered some of its usual coldness, yet the corners of her lips unconsciously lifted slightly. Gazing at her deliberately reserved demeanor, Chen Ji actually felt an urge to tease her. But he knew his limits—the timing was not yet right. He gathered his thoughts, then retrieved a jade slip from his chest. 'Since this is a life-and-death pact, there must be a witness.' He handed the jade slip before Ye Qing. 'Within this is recorded part of the Tianji Record's divination results—regarding the Holy Sect's future trajectory, and... the whereabouts of your sister Chen Nian.'

text.content: Chen Nian. The name struck like thunder in Ye Qing's mind. She jerked her head up, eyes filled with disbelief. 'You... you know news of my sister?' For three years, she had never revealed to anyone that she had a missing sister. Even in the Holy Sect's archives, there was no record of such a person. Yet this man before her treated her secret as a bargaining chip, calmly placing it before her. In that instant, complex emotions flooded her heart—shock, fear, the chilling realization of being completely seen through, and... a thread of secret anticipation.

choice.prompt: The life-and-death pact has been established, but the true trial is only beginning. What are your next plans for continuing the scheme?

choices.text: Reveal the truth on the spot
choices.description: Directly inform Ye Qing of Chen Nian's location and situation, trading sincerity for deeper cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more abilities of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing will completely lean toward you, and subsequent plans will gain intelligence from within the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: Intelligence leakage risk increases; if there is an insider, intentions may be exposed

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate, directly activating the jade slip. A illusory light rose from the jade slip, projecting the silhouette of a majestic palace. Deep within the palace, a delicate figure was imprisoned in the void by countless chains, her complexion deathly pale, eyes tightly shut. 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key—' Chen Ji's voice was low. 'The Holy Sect is using her bloodline power, attempting to open a path to the source of the Heavenly Dao.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stared fixedly at that illusory figure, her hands tightly clenched into fists, her fingernails deeply embedding into her palms. She wanted to roar, to demand why the Holy Sect would treat an innocent girl so cruelly, but she ultimately held back. Drawing a sharp breath, she turned to look at Chen Ji, her voice hoarse. 'How do you plan to rescue her?'

choices.description: Only reveal partial information, maintaining the advantage of information asymmetry, letting Ye Qing act according to your plan.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing may act irrationally due to anxiety
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute control over the situation, facilitating future deployment
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing discovers you are deliberately concealing information, trust may be affected

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved the jade slip, saying calmly: 'The timing is not yet right. You only need to know—she is alive, and the Holy Sect will not harm her for now.' His tone was placid as water. 'Before then, you need to fulfill your own duties. Regarding the Holy Sect—if there is any movement, inform me immediately.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's brow slightly furrowed, clearly dissatisfied with this vague answer. But she also knew this man never did anything without purpose. Since he did not say it, speaking would only cause harm. She lowered her gaze, suppressing the agitation in her heart, and softly said: 'Very well. I trust you.' These three words were spoken lightly, yet weighed like a thousand pounds.

choices.description: Leave the choice to Ye Qing, letting her decide for herself whether to know the truth and how to act.
choices.visible_cost: May lose partial control over the situation
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing will be utterly devoted to you, with loyalty reaching its peak
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's decisions may conflict with your overall plans

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly handed the Jade Slip to Ye Qing. 'The answer you seek lies within.' He said, 'But before you open it, I have a question for you—do you want a result that can save your sister, or do you want the process of saving your sister yourself?'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was stunned. She had never considered this question. For three years, her mind was filled only with the idea of 'saving her sister', never reflecting on the distinction between means and ends. She raised her head, locking eyes with Chen Ji for a long moment before speaking: 'Which do you want me to choose?'

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, revealing a meaningful smile: 'I never make choices for others. But I can tell you—whatever you choose, I will help you achieve your wish.' He spoke lightly, yet exuded absolute confidence. Ye Qing gazed into his eyes, suddenly feeling how laughable her three years of struggle and anxiety had seemed before him.

The night wind gradually subsided, and the star river slowly shifted westward. The two stood shoulder to shoulder at the Cliff Edge,沉默了许久. In the end, it was Ye Qing who broke the silence. 'I will not forget tonight.' Her voice regained its usual coldness, yet carried an indescribable tenderness. 'From now on, I will transmit intelligence from within the Holy Sect to you at once. In return—' She paused, 'I hope you can lend me a hand at critical moments.' She did not say 'save me', but 'lend me a hand'. Chen Ji understood the nuance perfectly. She did not want to be a weakling to be saved; she wanted to be a companion-in-arms.

Chen Ji nodded slightly, acknowledging this pact. He looked toward the distant horizon, where the silhouette of the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate was faintly visible. In a few days, the Sect Tournament would begin.届时，苏青瑶、凌渊、韩烈……那些或明或暗的对手，都会在那个舞台上与他相遇。而他手中，又将多出一张全新的底牌。He glanced at Ye Qing beside him, starlight sketching a soft outline on her profile. 'Ye Qing.' He suddenly spoke, his voice very light. 'Hmm?' She turned, her gaze meeting his. 'After tonight, we are in the same boat.' His lips curved slightly, 'So—pleased to work with you.' He spoke casually, yet Ye Qing sensed genuine warmth. She snorted coldly, turning away: 'None of that nonsense. But...' Her voice suddenly dropped, 'If you ever need help with anything, just say so. As long as it doesn't cross my bottom line—I can handle matters regarding the Holy Sect for you.'

Upon hearing this, a hint of playfulness flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. For the Holy Sect Saintess to make such a promise in person carried immense weight, beyond question. He did not rush to express gratitude, merely saying calmly: 'Then I'll owe you one.' Ye Qing shot him a glare, seemingly reproaching his poor social graces. Yet the faint smile at the corner of her lips betrayed her true mood. Beneath the starry sky, two silhouettes stood side by side—one as composed as an abyss, the other as coldly elegant as frost. If outsiders witnessed this scene, they would surely be stunned—the Holy Sect Saintess of the Demonic Path standing with the seemingly worthless Tianqing Sect disciple, like old friends.

'By the way.' Chen Ji suddenly remembered something, taking out a Communication Jade Talisman from his sleeve. 'This is a contact talisman I refined. After blood recognition, we can exchange messages within a thousand li.' He handed the talisman to Ye Qing. 'The Holy Sect's internal network is too complicated; using this will be safer.' Ye Qing took the talisman, her fingertips brushing its smooth surface. She could sense the Spiritual Energy fluctuation within—pure, restrained, yet fathomless. This small talisman must have cost considerable effort. She said nothing more, merely storing the talisman close to her body. 'There's one more thing.' Chen Ji's voice suddenly grew deeper. 'In recent days, there may be changes within the Holy Sect. Be careful after you return. If you encounter danger—' He paused, 'Contact me immediately.'

dialogue.content: 'Changes?' Ye Qing frowned slightly. 'What have you seen again?' Chen Ji shook his head, his expression even more solemn than before: 'In the Tianji Record's foresight, your face has always been blurred. This means—beings more powerful than you are interfering with the Heavenly Secrets related to you.' His gaze turned sharp. 'Within the Holy Sect, those capable of such means do not exceed three. Keep it in mind, but don't ask further.' Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's delicate body stiffened slightly. Of course she knew who Chen Ji meant—the three Supreme Elders of the Holy Sect, each capable of shaking the cultivation world with a single stomp. If even one of them had set sights on her... 'I'll be careful.' She took a deep breath, suppressing her unease. 'As for you, with the Sect Tournament approaching, about Ling Yuan—' She hesitated, clearly having great reverence for that old sect leader. 'No matter.' Chen Ji's lips curved into a faint smile. 'Old foxes have their uses. As long as used properly, they are the sharpest blade.'

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at his masterful appearance, her heart filled with mixed feelings of helplessness and admiration. This man was clearly of low cultivation, yet that aura of calculating the world made even her, the Holy Sect Saintess, feel ashamed. She suddenly remembered their first meeting—that time she only thought him the most insignificant waste of the Tianqing Sect, easily crushable. Yet never had she imagined that within this waste lay such astonishing ambition and means. Over three years, she watched him grow from a dispensable servant, step by step, into an existence even she had to look up to. The付出 and restraint in between probably exceeded her three years of undercover life in the Holy Sect a hundredfold.

choice.prompt: The star river faded, and dawn approached. Ye Qing is about to return to the Holy Sect. At this farewell moment, what will you say to her?

choices.description: Farewell with an equal attitude, emphasizing the identity of companions rather than a master-servant relationship.
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's identification with you further improves; after leaving, she will more actively cooperate with your plans
choices.risk_hint: May appear overly formal and polite, somewhat discordant with the intimate atmosphere just shared

text.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, watching her turn to leave, then suddenly spoke: 'Ye Qing.' She paused mid-step, turning to look back. Chen Ji gazed at her silhouette outlined by starlight, then softly said: 'Take care.' Only two words, simple to the point of perfunctory. Yet Ye Qing heard a different meaning within—this was not an instruction from master to servant, but a vigil between fellow travelers.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing froze for a moment, then her lips curved slightly, revealing a rare, genuine smile: 'You too.' With that, her form flashed, turning into a stream of ethereal purple light, vanishing into the night. Only Chen Ji remained, standing alone at the Cliff Edge, gazing at the direction of her departure, speechless for a long while.

choices.description: Emphasize the danger of the Holy Sect once more, urging her to act cautiously, and that she may abandon the mission to preserve herself if necessary.
choices.visible_cost: May appear overly worried, underestimating Ye Qing's abilities
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing will sense your concern and trust your judgment more at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might think you looked down on her.

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated for a moment, then suddenly said: "There is something I must remind you of." His voice turned especially serious. "Those three Grand Elders of the Holy Sect, any one of them has the ability to easily erase you from existence. If the situation becomes untenable, don't try to be brave—better to survive and fight another day."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, seemingly surprised by this "overprotective" gesture. But she didn't argue, only saying calmly: "Rest assured, I haven't lived long enough yet." She paused, then added: "Besides—I still want to witness you break the Heavenly Dao with my own eyes. Dying before that would be too much of a loss."

choices.description: Establishing a pact with her to break the Heavenly Dao, giving this cooperation a clear endpoint and vision.
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing will have a clear goal to strive for, giving her actions more motivation.
choices.risk_hint: The path of the Heavenly Dao stretches endlessly— whether this promise can be fulfilled remains an unknown.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly said: "When the day comes that we break the Heavenly Dao, I'll take you somewhere." Ye Qing was stunned: "Where?" His gaze grew distant: "On the shores of the Eastern Sea, there lies an unknown island. There, flowers bloom unfailingly all year round, spring forever lingers. When everything is over—" He paused. "How about we go there to grow old together?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was stunned. She had never expected this man, whose mind was always filled with calculations, to say something so... impractical. Growing old together? They still had such a long road ahead, and whether the Heavenly Dao could be broken was still unknown—how could they talk of growing old? Yet somehow, a warm current surged in her heart. "Alright." She heard her own voice, light as a dream. "It's a promise."

text.content: Above the cliff, the night wind had completely ceased. In the eastern sky, a hint of white was already appearing. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff's edge where dawn was about to break, gazing at the layered silhouettes of distant mountains, quietly calculating the chess game ahead. Ye Qing, this piece, had completely fallen into his grasp. The Holy Sect's intelligence network, the movements of the three Grand Elders, and the unsolved mystery of the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"—all of these would become new weapons in his hands. However, the larger the chessboard, the more one must consider. Lin Yuan's hidden arrows, Su Qingyao's investigation, Han Lie's threats... and that "Eye of the Heavenly Dao" always lurking behind the scenes. Every step felt like walking on thin ice.

He slowly spread open his palm and looked down. The wound on his palm had healed, leaving only a faint scar. The pale golden blood had dried, shimmering with a subtle glow in the dawn. A blood oath, a soul's vow—this was the first time since arriving in this world that he had truly bound himself to another person. Ye Qing, Chen Nian, the Tianji Record... these names flashed through his mind, finally converging into a vague silhouette. That was the future he had glimpsed countless times within the Tianji Record's mists, yet always unable to see clearly. "Heavenly Dao..." he murmured softly, a never-before determination flickering in his eyes. "Wait for me." Dawn broke, golden light spilling across the mountains and valleys. Chen Ji turned and walked toward the Tianqing Sect. His silhouette stretched long in the morning sun, as if reaching toward the unseen end of fate. Behind him, the remnants of last night's starlight were fading away, like an old era taking its final bow. And a new era was quietly beginning.
